documentation_scope.note: Publication records document the split at aggregated species/date/site level and do not export one record per image.

privacy_and_reproducibility.dataset_path_configuration: WADIDEGLA_DATA_DIR environment variable loaded from the local ~/.wadidegla.env configuration file or directly from the environment.
privacy_and_reproducibility.workspace_path_configuration: WADIDEGLA_WORKSPACE_DIR environment variable loaded from the local ~/.wadidegla.env configuration file or directly from the environment.

others_class.reason: The Others class is an aggregate non-target class rather than a single plant species.

random_train_validation_split.note: This seed refers specifically to image-level Train/Validation random partitioning.

date_separated_validation_selection_rule: For target species with sufficient collection-date coverage, validation collection date(s) were chosen primarily so that the resulting validation image count was as close as practical to approximately 20% of the species total while preserving collection-date separation between training and validation.
random_split_rule: Image-level random splitting was used for target species whose collection-date coverage was insufficient for a practical purely date-separated partition.
site_split_rule: For the site-separated target species, Train and Validation shared a collection date, but images from that date were assigned according to distinct sampling sites rather than by image-level random splitting.
